title: Scan station
subtitle: Turn a scanned pile into one copy per student, then check them with AI.
loadFailed: Could not open the scan station. Try again.
readOnly: The copies are made. Press Change something to edit them.

off.title: Scan station is not switched on for this institute
off.body: Until it is, upload one PDF per student from Check with AI → Upload copies.

steps.title: How it works

one.title: Scan the pile
one.body: Put the answer sheets in your scanner and scan them into a folder, as JPEG or PDF.

two.title: Turn the pile over
two.body: Turn the whole pile over, like turning a book page, and scan it again into a second folder.

three.title: Add both scans here
three.body: Add the two folders as one load. Scan the next pile as the next load.

steps.modes: Both passes in one folder, or a scanner that does both sides, work too: choose how you scanned when you add a load.

sessions.title: Scan sessions for this test
sessions.createFailed: Could not start a scan session.
sessions.notFound: This scan session could not be opened.

addLoad.hint: You can add the next load while earlier ones are being read.
addLoad.full: This session has the most loads it can take ({{max}}).
addLoad.title: Add load {{load}}

TWO_PASSES.title: Two passes
TWO_PASSES.body: Fronts and backs in two folders (recommended).

ONE_FOLDER.title: Both passes in one folder
ONE_FOLDER.body: Scanned one after the other into the same folder.

DUPLEX.title: My scanner does both sides
DUPLEX.body: Each sheet saved as front, back, front, back.

intake.drop: Drop a folder or files here
intake.pickFailed: Could not read that folder. Try choosing the files instead.

source.NUMERIC_SUFFIX: the number in the file name
source.MODIFIED_TIME: the time each file was saved
source.NAME: file name

intake.ready: {{a}} + {{b}} pages, nothing missing. Ready to upload.
intake.splitAsk: {{first}} + {{second}} pages, split after {{name}}. Does that look right?
intake.duplexUntested: Two-sided scanners have not been tested yet. Check the copies carefully.

errors.COUNT_MISMATCH: First pass has {{a}} pages, second has {{b}}. A sheet was pulled in twice or skipped. Rescan this load.
errors.DUPLICATE_INDEX: {{pass}}: {{names}} has the same number as another page.
errors.MIXED_STEMS: {{pass}}: the files come from two different scans. Keep one scan per folder.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE: {{names}} can't be used. Save scans as JPEG, PNG or PDF (not HEIC or TIFF).
errors.PDF_UNREADABLE: {{names}} would not open as a PDF.
errors.TOO_MANY_PAGES: A pass can have at most {{max}} pages. Scan the pile in smaller loads.
errors.DUPLICATE_FILE: {{names}} is the same file as another one.
errors.MIXED_KINDS: A pass mixes PDFs and images. Scan each pass in one format.
errors.NO_CLEAR_GAP: Couldn't tell where the second pass starts. Choose Two passes and add each pass on its own.
errors.ODD_COUNT: The folder has {{count}} pages, an odd number, so it can't be two equal passes.

warnings.MTIME_DISAGREES: {{pass}}: the times the files were saved don't follow the page numbers. Check the order; this load will be marked for a look.

intake.uploadFailed: {{name}} did not upload, so nothing was sent. Try again.
intake.added: Load {{load}} added. Reading names and pairing sides…

load.title: Load {{load}}
load.failed: This load could not be read. {{message}}
load.removeConfirm: Remove load {{load}}? Its copies leave this session.

blanks.title: Blank backs left out of load {{load}}
blanks.help: These backs look empty and won't be in the copies. Click a page to keep it.
blanks.none: No pages are being left out.

copies.empty: Copies appear here once a load has been read.
copies.onlyReview: Only copies that need a look

copy.title: Copy {{n}}
copy.noName: Name not readable — will be matched by hand
copy.excluded: Left out: this copy won't be checked.
copy.firstSheetHelp: The first sheet has no name box. If the pile was scanned the other way round, try the fronts in the other order. Otherwise mark where the copy starts, or leave it out.

tryDirection.FORWARD: Try the fronts in scan order
tryDirection.REVERSED: Try the fronts in reverse order

pair.title: Check the pair
pair.help: Is this back the other side of this front? Compare the handwriting, the paper edges and any ink showing through.

direction.title: Which way are the fronts?
direction.help: We could not tell whether the fronts came out first to last or last to first. Pick the order in which the copy starts with the name box.
direction.none: No copy has more than one sheet yet, so the order does not change anything.

verdict.EMPTY: Add the first load to begin.
verdict.BLOCKED_one: {{count}} problem needs a rescan or a fix
verdict.BLOCKED_other: {{count}} problems need a rescan or a fix

bar.aiBusy: The AI service is busy. The copies will be made as soon as it is free; you can keep this page open or come back later.

start.title: Start checking
start.intro_one: {{count}} copy ({{pages}} pages) goes to the AI check. It is matched to a student by the name on it; if it can't be matched, it waits for you in Bulk checks.
start.intro_other: {{count}} copies ({{pages}} pages) go to the AI check. Each is matched to a student by the name on it; any that can't be matched wait for you in Bulk checks.
start.insufficient: There are not enough credits for all these copies. Add credits to the institute.
start.notifyEmail: Email me when the checks are done
start.planChanged: The copies changed after they were made, so checking did not start. Make the copies again, then start checking.
start.noRoute: Checking has started. Open the test's Submissions tab to follow it.

started.title: Checking has started
started.body: The copies are in Bulk checks. Names that could not be matched wait there for you.

errors.locked: The session changed in the meantime. It has been refreshed; please try again.
errors.copyChanged: This copy changed while you were looking at it. It has been refreshed; check it again before you accept it.
errors.flagChanged: This changed while you were looking at it. It has been refreshed; check it again before you accept it.
errors.blanksChanged: The pages being left out as blank changed. They have been refreshed; check them again.

COUNT_MISMATCH.title: Page counts differ
COUNT_MISMATCH.help: The two passes have a different number of pages. Rescan this load.

FILE_UNREADABLE.title: A file could not be read
FILE_UNREADABLE.help: One of the scanned files would not open. Rescan this load.

NO_NAME_BOX_FOUND.title: No name box found
NO_NAME_BOX_FOUND.help: No page in this load has the printed name box. Check that the right sheets were scanned, then rescan.

LOAD_TOO_LARGE.title: Load too large
LOAD_TOO_LARGE.help: This load has too many pages. Scan the pile in smaller loads.

PAIR_SHIFT_DETECTED.title: Pages are shifted
PAIR_SHIFT_DETECTED.help: From one sheet on, every back matches the next front: a sheet was pulled in twice or skipped. Rescan this load.

BACK_HAS_LABEL.title: A sheet was turned over
BACK_HAS_LABEL.help: A back page has the printed name box, so a sheet went in the wrong way up. Rescan this load.

LABEL_NO_VALUE.title: Name box is empty
LABEL_NO_VALUE.help: The name box was found but nothing could be read in it. The copy will be matched by hand.

LABEL_UNUSUAL.title: Name box looks different
LABEL_UNUSUAL.help: This name box does not look like the others. Check that it starts a new copy.

PAIR_NOT_ROW_MAX.title: Back may be wrong
PAIR_NOT_ROW_MAX.help: This back is not a clear match for its front. Look at the pair.

ORDER_UNCERTAIN.title: Back order unclear
ORDER_UNCERTAIN.help: We could not tell for sure which way the backs came out. Look at a pair.

FRONT_BLANK.title: Front looks blank
FRONT_BLANK.help: A front page looks empty. Check that it is the right page.

DPI_LOW.title: Low scan quality
DPI_LOW.help: The scan resolution is low; handwriting may not read well. Rescan at a higher resolution if you can.

BLANK_RULE_SUSPECT.title: Blank backs kept
BLANK_RULE_SUSPECT.help: Too many pages looked blank, so no back was left out of this load.

DPI_ASSUMED.title: Scan resolution assumed
DPI_ASSUMED.help: The files did not say their resolution, so a standard one was assumed.

UNSURE_KEPT.title: Faint pages kept
UNSURE_KEPT.help: Some backs might be blank but were kept to be safe.

ANALYSIS_FAILED.title: Could not read this load
ANALYSIS_FAILED.help: Reading this load failed. Rescan it or remove it.

FIRST_SHEET_NO_LABEL.title: First sheet has no name box
FIRST_SHEET_NO_LABEL.help: The very first sheet should start a copy. If the pile was scanned the other way round, try the fronts in the other order; otherwise mark it as the start of a copy, leave it out, or rescan.

TOO_MANY_COPIES.title: Too many copies
TOO_MANY_COPIES.help: This session has more copies than it can take. Remove a load and scan it in a new session.

FRONT_ORDER_UNCERTAIN.title: Fronts order unclear
FRONT_ORDER_UNCERTAIN.help: Pick which way the fronts came out of the scanner.

LOAD_STARTS_MID_COPY.title: Load starts mid-copy
LOAD_STARTS_MID_COPY.help: This load's first sheet has no name box, so it was joined to the last copy of the previous load. Check it.

SAME_NAME.title: Same name twice
SAME_NAME.help: Another copy has the same name. Check that two copies were not merged or split wrongly.

COPY_UNUSUALLY_LONG.title: Copy is unusually long
COPY_UNUSUALLY_LONG.help: This copy has many more sheets than the others. A name box may have been missed.

TOO_MANY_PAGES.title: Many pages
TOO_MANY_PAGES.help: This copy has more than 40 pages. Check that it is one student's copy.

BLANKS_TO_CONFIRM.title: Check the blank pages
BLANKS_TO_CONFIRM.help: Some backs will be left out as blank. Take a quick look before the copies are made.

MTIME_DISAGREES.title: File times out of order
MTIME_DISAGREES.help: The times the files were saved don't follow the page numbers. Check the scan order.

NO_COPIES.title: No copies to make
NO_COPIES.help: Every copy is left out. Include at least one copy to go on.
